#!/bin/bash

# Function to extract function name from context
get_function_context() {
    local file=$1
    local linenum=$2
    
    # Search backwards from the line for the function definition
    awk -v startline=$linenum 'BEGIN{found=0; lineno=1} 
    FNR <= startline { 
        if (/^func \(/) { found=FNR; fname=$0 }
        if (/^func [A-Za-z_]/) { found=FNR; fname=$0 }
    }
    END { if(found > 0) print fname }' "$file"
}

        # Extract context
        context=$(awk -v target=$linenum 'BEGIN{fname=""} 
        /^func / { fname=$0 }
        NR==target { print fname; exit }' "$file")
        
        if [ -z "$context" ]; then
            # Try searching backwards
            context=$(sed -n "1,${linenum}p" "$file" | grep "^func " | tail -1)
        fi
        
        # Only print if we found a function

        fi
    done
    echo ""
done
